implementation.workflow: Manual main-only, read-only-permission macOS matrix for fixed Build 16 and Build 17 source SHAs, crash UUIDs, versions, builds, and offsets.
implementation.source_fidelity: Reuses the historical release label macos-latest and Flutter 3.47.2, records current Xcode/Swift/CocoaPods provenance, and records that neither historical commit contains ios/Podfile.lock.
implementation.variants: Reproduces the production sequence as two explicit variants: Flutter no-code-sign preparation build and an ephemeral unsigned Xcode archive. The archive variant is preferred; the preparation variant is allowed only when its own Runner and dSYM exactly match the crash UUID.
implementation.symbolication_gate: For each selected variant, crash UUID, arm64 Runner UUID, and that variant's arm64 dSYM UUID must all match; dSYM verification, __TEXT range validation, and resolvable atos function output must pass. If both variants match, their sanitized frames must be identical.
implementation.secret_boundary: The canonical protected Firebase plist is decoded in one dedicated step, passed to reconstruction as an owner-only temporary file path rather than a secret environment value, removed before archive to mirror production, and deleted before annotations/artifact upload.
implementation.output_boundary: Only bounded function/module/file-basename/line data, variant states, UUIDs, toolchain provenance, and fixed internal reasons are emitted. Raw .ips, app, dSYM, xcarchive, IPA, logs, plist, secrets, and signing material are never uploaded.
implementation.release_boundary: No signing identity other than an explicitly empty archive override, no team/profile/certificate/keychain, no exportArchive, no IPA, no altool/Transporter/ASC upload, and no Build 18 path.
implementation.parity_inventory: The source-level table records Firebase, Supabase/auth, maps, notifications, microphone, speech, photo/file, Widget/App Group, deep links, secure storage, Ads/UMP/rewarded, analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config, offline, lifecycle, sharing, and review flow. Ads/UMP/rewarded are the only identified iOS diagnostic disable family; runtime restoration remains configuration- and RCA-gated.
